item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00328","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C20","C07","C10"],"selected_candidate_label":"C20","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C20 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s Red Cross campaign appeal. Both directives explain the campaign’s urgency through the Red Cross’s services to military personnel and its blood-collection work, then culminate in an express appeal for support. The child substantially expands and adapts that framework for an internal federal workforce campaign, including appointment of a Government Unit chairman and instructions to field offices. C07 and C10 share relevant Red Cross subject matter and some distinctive themes, but neither parallels the child’s campaign structure as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Red Cross continues its vital services to the Armed Forces, veterans and their families... The Red Cross collects blood to meet the urgent needs of the wounded","parent_excerpt":"It is serving our fighting men on the battlefields and at the training centers... It is gathering blood to save military and civilian lives.","explanation":"Both use the same paired justification for the fundraising campaign: service to military personnel and collection of blood."},{"child_excerpt":"The success of the Red Cross campaign... depends to a great extent on the gifts of those working in the various local, Federal and International agencies.","parent_excerpt":"I want everyone—particularly those who have not yet made their contribution—to know how vital the success of this campaign is","explanation":"Both frame individual contributions as necessary to the campaign’s success."},{"child_excerpt":"I urge every one to pledge to Mr. Martin his unqualified assistance.","parent_excerpt":"I urge my fellow Americans to give generously and promptly to the 1951 Red Cross Fund Campaign.","explanation":"Each concludes its campaign case with a presidential exhortation to provide immediate support."}]}
